packages.description: Service management workflows for Claude Code and Codex.

summaries.packages/itil/skills/capture-problem/SKI: Record a problem during ongoing work, with its impact, job trace and index entry.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/capture-story/SKILL: Record a delivery story with problem, job and story-map traces.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/capture-story-map/S: Draft a story map connecting a problem and desired outcomes to coordinated delivery.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/manage-rfc/SKILL.md: Manage a problem-traced release row and its delivery stories.
Create, refine and advance a delivery story through its lifecycle.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/manage-story-map/SK: Create, refine and manage a story map for coordinated delivery.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/restore-incident/SK: Record observed service restoration and hand the underlying cause to problem management.
summaries.packages/risk-scorer/skills/pipeline/SKI: Internal pipeline-risk helper; use assess-release for the public review workflow.
summaries.packages/risk-scorer/skills/external-com: Internal outbound-prose review helper; use assess-external-comms for the public review workflow.
summaries.packages/risk-scorer/skills/wip/SKILL.md: Internal review helper for work in progress; use assess-wip for the public review workflow.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/list-problems/SKILL: List open and known-error problems ordered by weighted priority.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/reconcile-readme/SK: Detect and correct drift between the problem index and its on-disk inventory.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/review-problems/SKI: Reassess open and known-error problems, their risks, effort and priority.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/close-incident/SKIL: Close a restored incident after checking the linked problem’s status or a documented justification for having no linked problem.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/link-incident/SKILL: Link an incident to an existing problem and record that problem’s current status.
summaries.packages/architect/skills/capture-adr/SK: Record an architecture decision from the current conversation during ongoing work.
summaries.packages/architect/skills/create-adr/SKI: Create an architecture decision record describing the problem, options and chosen approach.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/capture-rfc/SKILL.m: Add an RFC release row to a story map, connecting a problem to stories delivered together.
List delivery stories and their status as a Markdown table.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/manage-problem/SKIL: Create, update and prioritise problems using their impact, likelihood and estimated effort.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/migrate-story-map/S: Replace an eligible legacy story map using a complete mapping approved by the adopter.
Investigate and repair the highest-priority eligible problem, then follow the project’s delivery workflow.
summaries.packages/retrospective/skills/migrate-br: Split an existing project briefing into topic files for subsequent sessions.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/outcome-led-plannin: Compatibility entrypoint for outcome-led planning, including optional GitHub coordination. Existing ITIL installations remain usable.
summaries.packages/planning/skills/outcome-led-pla: Confirm a SMART outcome and deliver through Now, Next and Later increments. Obtain five independent reviews of each initial or materially revised plan. Remember the project tracking choice and reconcile shared tickets and selected Project views at work checkpoints.
summaries.packages/planning/skills/contribute/SKIL: Find useful bounded help within an assessed outcome, reuse its saved tracking choice and keep shared evidence current.
summaries.packages/planning/skills/setup-github-tr: Configure missing selected GitHub issue tracking and Project fields and views. Reuse saved choices and complete setup, with Increments hierarchy saved On.
summaries.packages/itil/skills/setup-github-tracki: Configure missing selected GitHub issue tracking and Project fields and views. Reuse saved choices and complete setup, with Increments hierarchy saved On.
